events.title: MCP donated to Linux Foundation
events.summary: Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation on December 9, 2025 — making the AI-tooling standard vendor-neutral alongside OpenAI's AGENTS.md.
events.about: A year after MCP's public launch, Anthropic moved governance to the AAIF with co-founders Block and OpenAI and backing from Google, Microsoft, and AWS. The donation cemented MCP as the default wire format connecting LLMs to databases, IDEs, and SaaS — used by Cursor, Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT.

narrative.whyChosen: MCP's Linux Foundation donation turned Anthropic's experiment into industry infrastructure.
narrative.whyImportant: Vendor-neutral governance let enterprises adopt agent tooling without single-vendor lock-in.
narrative.problemSolved: Every AI product reinvented tool-calling integrations with incompatible APIs.

events.title: OpenAI GPT-5.2 released
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.2 on December 11, 2025 — a December refresh with fewer factual errors, stronger math, and GPT-5.2-Codex for agentic coding.
events.about: GPT-5.2 answered Google's Gemini 3 launch with improved Thinking mode and enterprise knowledge-work benchmarks. It set the baseline that GPT-5.3-Codex and GPT-5.4 would extend in 2026 — closing OpenAI's competitive gap after a busy November for Google and Anthropic.

narrative.whyChosen: GPT-5.2 was OpenAI's year-end response to Gemini 3 and Claude Opus 4.5.
narrative.whyImportant: Lower hallucination rates and Codex integration kept OpenAI in the three-way frontier race.
narrative.problemSolved: GPT-5.1 users wanted better factual accuracy and coding without waiting for GPT-6.

events.title: Google Gemini 3 Flash released
events.summary: Google released Gemini 3 Flash on December 17, 2025 — a fast, low-cost 3-series model that became the default in the Gemini app and Antigravity.
events.about: Gemini 3 Flash matched much of 3 Pro's agentic coding at under a quarter the cost — Google's play for high-volume API and IDE workloads. It replaced Gemini 2.5 Flash as the default consumer model days before OpenAI shipped GPT-5.2.

narrative.whyChosen: Gemini 3 Flash made frontier-tier speed the default, not a premium upsell.
narrative.whyImportant: Cheap fast reasoning shifted API economics toward high-token agent loops.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers needed 3 Pro-quality agents without 3 Pro pricing on every request.
